notes.text:
This update for apache2-mod_auth_openidc fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2019-14857: Fixed an open redirect issue that exists in URLs with trailing slashes (bsc#1153666).

notes.text: A flaw was found in mod_auth_openidc before version 2.4.0.1. An open redirect issue exists in URLs with trailing slashes similar to CVE-2019-3877 in mod_auth_mellon.
